rationale: Retire Apollo's collective 50% ownership period and mark Broad Reach Power realized. Apollo-managed infrastructure funds completed the aggregate investment in December 2021, and Apollo confirms AIOF II participated without disclosing its individual allocation. EnCap and Apollo announced the sale to ENGIE in August 2023, ENGIE's audited financial statements state that the acquisition of 100% of Broad Reach Power was finalized in October 2023, and EnCap now classifies the company as realized in 2023. Preserve the excluded Mountain West portfolio caveat without treating it as evidence that Apollo continued to own the sold Broad Reach Power platform.

beforeImage.name: Broad Reach Power
beforeImage.description: Broad Reach Power develops and operates renewable generation and battery storage projects in the United States. Its end markets are utilities and wholesale power counterparties, and the business follows an asset-heavy development and ownership model across solar, wind, and storage. Apollo acquired a 50% stake in the company in 2021 alongside the existing EnCap-led shareholder group. In 2023, the shareholders agreed to sell Broad Reach's battery storage business to ENGIE, while public transaction materials stated that the Mountain West solar, wind, and storage portfolio was excluded from that sale. Reviewed public sources do not disclose the current ownership structure of the retained Mountain West portfolio after the 2023 transaction.

afterImage.name: Broad Reach Power
afterImage.description: Broad Reach Power was a Houston-based utility-scale battery storage and renewable-energy platform founded by EnCap Energy Transition in 2019. Apollo-managed infrastructure funds collectively acquired a 50% stake in December 2021 alongside the EnCap-led shareholder group. Apollo confirms that Apollo Infrastructure Opportunities Fund II participated, but its individual allocation was not publicly disclosed. EnCap and Apollo announced the sale of Broad Reach Power's battery-storage business to ENGIE in August 2023, excluding 1.8 GW of solar and wind projects and 4 GWh of Mountain West battery projects from the transaction perimeter. ENGIE finalized its acquisition of 100% of Broad Reach Power from EnCap and Apollo in October 2023 and fully consolidated the acquired business. EnCap now classifies Broad Reach Power as realized in 2023, and no current Apollo ownership or subsequent reacquisition was found through August 8, 2026. The excluded Mountain West projects are not treated as a current Apollo-owned Broad Reach Power company without direct post-closing ownership evidence.
